load_motion_from_npz: load a Motion object from an NPZ file containing bone positions, quaternions, and hierarchy data
load_motion_from_bvh: load a Motion object from a BVH file with optional scale, mirror axis, and joint corrections
load_motion_from_glb: load a Motion object from a GLB file with optional bone name filtering and floor alignment
get_bone_transformations: get bone transformation matrices for specified timestamps and bones with optional mirroring support
get_bone_velocities: compute bone velocities at given timestamps by sampling positions at adjacent time steps
